# DealCatcher — Professional Websites for Businesses

> DealCatcher builds AI-ready, WCAG compliant websites that convert visitors into customers. We serve Norwegian craftsmen, service providers, and Polish businesses.

## Services

- Custom website design and development (Next.js, React)
- WCAG 2.1 AA compliance audits and implementation
- Google Ads campaign management
- SEO optimization and AI search readiness
- Website hosting and maintenance

## Pricing

- Starter: From 10,000 NOK / 3,000 PLN (one-time) + hosting from 500 NOK / 200 PLN per month
- Growth: From 15,000 NOK / 6,000 PLN (one-time) + hosting from 1,000 NOK / 400 PLN per month
- Accelerator: From 18,000 NOK / 7,000 PLN (one-time) + hosting from 3,500 NOK / 1,400 PLN per month
